title: Indian Rupee: RBI seen starting mini hiking cycle - Societe Generale
summary: Societe Generale’s Kunal Kundu expects the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to respond to India’s broadening inflation pressures with a new mini rate-hike cycle. Kundu projects a 25bp hike in October, followed by two similar moves in December and February.

title: Federal Reserve: Rate hiking path and global yields – BNY
summary: BNY’s John Velis expects the Federal Reserve to raise rates by 25bp at this week’s FOMC meeting and sees another hike as likely later this year.
